**Explicit evaluation of the q-Stokes matrices for certain confluent hypergeometric q-difference equations**

*Jinghong Lin, Yiming Ma and Xiaomeng Xu*

28 pp, 15 sections.

**Abstract.** We prove a connection formula for the basic hypergeomtric fu nction nϕn−1 (a1,...,a n−1, 0;b1,...,b n−1;q,z ) by using the q-Borel resummation. As an application, we compute q-Stokes matrices of a special conﬂuent hypergeometricq-diﬀerence system with an irregular singularity. We show th at by letting q → 1, the q-Stokes matrices recover the known expressions of the Stokes matric es of the corresponding conﬂuent hypergeometric diﬀerential system.
